headline: Paushak reports 52% revenue growth in September quarter
summary: Paushak reported standalone net sales of Rs 89.32 crore for the quarter ended September 2026. This represents a 51.96% increase compared to the same period last year. The company's financial performance reflects significant year-on-year growth in its top-line figures.
why_it_matters: Strong revenue growth may signal improved demand for specialty chemicals.
